title: </sub>  Close the cohort before any finding is visible
text:
</sub>  Close the cohort before any finding is visible

When real-PR evidence starts accumulating, this only requires closing the cohort before adjudication, but AC15 requires a cutoff fixed before any eligible pass's findings are visible. Because this is the operator-maintained ledger that governs promotion to `real_pr_measured`, the weaker rule permits selecting the cohort after observing results and can produce an outcome-selected measurement; record the cutoff and eligible heads before their review results are observed.
